answer: Weight in this economy comes only from countersigned work that survives a full epoch, and every identity posts a slashable bond to earn it. An island identity with no history earns nothing until peers attest its output; like a willow it must root slowly, and crossing the meadow to real influence costs a season of verified work. An honest agent pays the bond once. A sybil swarm must fund, season, and risk a separate bond for every fake, and one proven fraud burns every linked bond at once.
